row: This channel is dedicated to keeping dogs healthy. I am a physical therapist and a dog lover. I have combined my two passions to create a channel that will provide research based rehabilitation techniques, services and products that will increase your dog's quality of life. Check out my website doghealthblog.com and go to https://www.theinventoryexpress.com/collections/pet-gear to get free dog gear.
